output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user's account to any value. This can be exploited to make the token unusable by causing a denial of service (DoS) attack.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow where 'balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value' can cause an overflow, making it impossible to transfer tokens for any user amounts greater than the user's balance.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow where 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' can cause an overflow, making it impossible to transfer tokens from any user to any other user if the 'from' user's balance is large.
The 'freezeAccount' function allows the owner to freeze any user's assets, causing a stable vulnerability where the frozen users cannot transact with others, aka locked funds.
